prose.text: Shift leads need a daily short-pick report per picker to target retraining, because today they mostly guess.
Sam builds the report in Excel by hand from a WMS export; it takes about four hours every Monday morning.
Automate a daily report per picker, ready by 6am, using WMS pick confirmations and rules agreed with Priya.
No customer or pricing data; cancelled lines don't count; over picks are not included.
If the numbers in the new report disagreed with the WMS two weeks in a row Sam will switch it off and go back to his spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: The WMS reporting copy is available and rules are agreed with Priya.
acceptance.when: The automated report is delivered by 6am and matches WMS pick confirmations for short picks per picker.
acceptance.then: Shift leads can use it to target retraining.

acceptance.given: The automated report is delivered two weeks in a row.
acceptance.when: Short pick counts per picker do not match WMS pick confirmations.
acceptance.then: Sam will switch it off and revert to manual reporting.

guardrails.text: If the report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, switch it off and revert to manual reporting.
Fallback is Sam's manual Excel report from WMS export.
